name: Milpitas Lifeguard / Swim Instructor (part-time, ages 15+)
org: City of Milpitas Recreation and Community Services
what_you_do: Guard swimmers at the Milpitas Sports Center pool and teach swim lessons to kids and adults. You also help keep the pool area clean and safe.
who_can_apply: At least 15 at the time of hire. You must pass a swim skills test through a Lifeguard Academy before you are hired. Experience with kids and adults is preferred, not required.
duration: Part-time, year-round and seasonal. Shifts are usually 4 hours. August to June: Monday to Saturday, 5:30 am to 8:30 pm. Summer: daily, 5:30 am to 9 pm.
deadline_text: Closing date: Continuous. Open until filled and may close at any time. Applications are screened on a regular basis.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the Milpitas city job board. Before you are hired, you must pass a swim test at a Lifeguard Academy.
notes: This posting first opened Sep 3, 2024 and is still listed as continuous. Its application questions still mention 2024-25 shifts, so call 408-586-3090 to check current hiring. A TB test is required. Fingerprints are only required if you are 18 or older.
